en.s: The Battle of Alnwick (1174) is one of two battles fought near the town of Alnwick, in Northumberland, England. In the battle, which occurred on 13 July 1174, William I of Scotland, also known as William the Lion, was captured by a small English force led by Ranulf de Glanvill.

zh.s: 1174年阿尼克战役是英格兰诺森伯兰郡阿尼克镇附近发生的两场战斗之一。战斗于1174年7月13日发生，苏格兰国王威廉一世（又称狮子威廉）被拉努尔夫·德·格兰维尔率领的一支小规模英军俘虏。

en.s: A coronation ceremony marks the formal investiture of a monarch with regal power using a crown. In addition to the crowning, this ceremony may include the presentation of other items of regalia, and other rituals such as the taking of special vows by the new monarch, the investing and presentation of regalia to them, and acts of homage by the new monarch's subjects.
en.n: Coronation of Alexander III as King of Scots.

zh.s: 加冕礼是通过加冠仪式，正式授予君主王权的典礼。典礼还可能包括授予其他王室礼器，以及新君主宣誓、接受并展示礼器、臣民向新君主行礼等仪式。
zh.n: 亚历山大三世加冕为苏格兰国王。

en.s: The Battle of Durbe (Latvian: Durbes kauja, Lithuanian: Durbės mūšis, German: Schlacht an der Durbe) was a medieval battle fought near Durbe, 23 km (14 mi) east of Liepāja, in present-day Latvia during the Livonian Crusade. On 13 July 1260, the Samogitians soundly defeated the joint forces of the Teutonic Knights from Prussia and Livonian Order from Livonia. Some 150 knights were killed, including Livonian Master Burchard von Hornhausen and Prussian Land Marshal Henrik Botel. It was by far the largest defeat of the knights in the 13th century: in the second-largest, the Battle of Aizkraukle, 71 knights were killed.

zh.s: 杜尔贝战役（拉脱维亚语：Durbes kauja；立陶宛语：Durbės mūšis；德语：Schlacht an der Durbe）是立窝尼亚十字军东征期间的一场中世纪战役，发生在今拉脱维亚的杜尔贝附近，地点在利耶帕亚以东23公里（14英里）。1260年7月13日，萨莫吉希亚人彻底击败了普鲁士条顿骑士团和立窝尼亚骑士团的联军。约150名骑士阵亡，其中包括立窝尼亚骑士团团长布尔夏德·冯·霍恩豪森和普鲁士陆军元帅亨里克·博特尔。这是13世纪骑士团遭遇的最大惨败，第二大惨败——艾兹克劳克莱战役——有71名骑士阵亡。

en.s: Lancaster's chevauchée of 1356 in Normandy was an English offensive directed by Henry, Duke of Lancaster, in northern France during 1356, as a part of the Hundred Years' War. The offensive took the form of a large mounted raid – a chevauchée – and lasted from 22 June to 13 July. During its final week the English were pursued by a much larger French army under King John II that failed to force them to battle.

zh.s: 1356年兰开斯特在诺曼底的骑兵袭掠是百年战争期间的一场英军攻势，由兰开斯特公爵亨利率领，在法国北部展开。英军以大规模骑兵袭扰的方式作战，从6月22日持续到7月13日。最后一周，约翰二世国王率领规模大得多的法军追击英军，但未能迫使他们交战。

en.s: The Jingnan campaign, or the campaign to clear away disorders, was a three-year civil war from 1399 to 1402 in the early years of the Ming dynasty of China between the Jianwen Emperor and his uncle, Zhu Di, Prince of Yan. The war was sparked by the removal of the Emperor's uncles and the restriction of Zhu Di's power by the central government after the Jianwen Emperor ascended to the throne in 1398.

zh.s: 靖难之役又称清除祸乱之战，是中国明朝初年建文帝与其叔父燕王朱棣之间的一场内战，持续三年，从1399年至1402年。建文帝于1398年即位后，朝廷削除诸王并限制朱棣的权力，由此引发战争。

en.s: The Battle of Gravelines was fought on 13 July 1558 at Gravelines, near Calais, France. It occurred during the twelve-year war between France and Spain (1547–1559). The battle resulted in a victory by the Spanish forces, led by Lamoral, Count of Egmont, over the French, led by Marshal Paul de Thermes. The Spanish were supported by the English Navy, who opened fire on the French as they reached the sand dunes at Gravelines. Following the dominance of the Spanish forces, led by Duke Emmanuel Philibert of Savoy, at the Battle of San Quentin, Henry II of France prepared his revenge.

zh.s: 格拉沃利讷战役于1558年7月13日在法国加莱附近的格拉沃利讷发生，属于1547年至1559年法国与西班牙之间的战争。由埃格蒙特伯爵拉莫拉尔率领的西班牙军队击败了由保罗·德·泰尔姆元帅率领的法国军队。英国海军支援西班牙，在法军抵达格拉沃利讷沙丘时向其开火。萨伏依公爵埃马纽埃莱·菲利贝托率领的西班牙军队此前已在圣康坦战役中占据上风，法国国王亨利二世准备复仇。

en.s: The siege of Haarlem was an episode of the Eighty Years' War. From 11 December 1572 to 13 July 1573 an army of Philip II of Spain laid bloody siege to the city of Haarlem in the Netherlands, whose loyalties had begun wavering during the previous summer. After the naval battle of Haarlemmermeer and the defeat of a land relief force, the starving city surrendered and the garrison was massacred.
en.n: Eighty Years' War: The Siege of Haarlem ends after seven months.

zh.s: 哈勒姆围城战是八十年战争中的一场战役。1572年12月11日至1573年7月13日，西班牙国王腓力二世的军队对荷兰城市哈勒姆展开残酷围攻；该城此前一年夏天已开始动摇对西班牙的效忠。哈勒默湖海战结束、陆上援军被击败后，饥困的城中守军投降，随后遭到屠杀。
zh.n: 八十年战争：哈勒姆围城战在持续七个月后结束。

en.s: The Battle of Pantelleria (1586) also known as the Fight at Pantalarea was a naval engagement that took place during the Anglo–Spanish War off the island of Pantelleria on the 13 July 1586. The encounter was between an English armed merchant fleet of five ships of the Levant Company in convoy under Edward Wilkinson and a fleet of eleven Spanish and Maltese galleys under Don Pedro de Leyva. The English managed to repel all the attacks and returned home unmolested. Although minor the battle had significant consequences in testing English firepower of which was to be used against the Spanish armada two years later when England was under threat of invasion.

zh.s: 潘泰莱里亚海战又称潘塔拉雷亚战斗，是英西战争期间于1586年7月13日在潘泰莱里亚岛附近发生的一场海战。交战双方是爱德华·威尔金森率领的英国黎凡特公司商船队（5艘武装船只）和唐·佩德罗·德·莱瓦率领的西班牙、马耳他舰队（11艘桨帆船）。英方击退了所有进攻，安然返航。虽然战斗规模不大，但它帮助英国检验了火力；两年后英国面临入侵威胁时，这些经验被用于对付西班牙无敌舰队。

en.s: The Levant Company was an English chartered company formed in 1592. Elizabeth I of England approved its initial charter on 11 September 1592 when the Venice Company (1583) and the Turkey Company (1581) merged, because their charters had expired, as she was eager to maintain trade and political alliances with the Ottoman Empire.

zh.t: 英西战争：黎凡特公司一支英国船队在地中海潘泰莱里亚岛附近击退11艘西班牙和马耳他桨帆船
zh.s: 黎凡特公司是一家英国特许公司，成立于1592年。英格兰女王伊丽莎白一世于1592年9月11日批准其最初特许状；当时，威尼斯公司（1583年）与土耳其公司（1581年）合并，因为两者的特许状均已到期，而女王希望维持与奥斯曼帝国的贸易和政治联盟。

en.s: The Battle of the Dalmatian Coast of 1624 was a naval battle between a Spanish, Genoese and Maltese fleet captained by Álvaro de Bazán y Benavides, Marquis of Santa Cruz and a Barbary corsair fleet from Tunis and Algiers, originally pursued by him before the previous Battle of the Gulf of Tunis. It resulted in a Christian victory.

zh.s: 1624年的达尔马提亚海岸战役是一场海战，交战双方分别是由圣克鲁斯侯爵阿尔瓦罗·德·巴赞·贝纳维德斯指挥的西班牙、热那亚和马耳他舰队，以及来自突尼斯和阿尔及尔的巴巴里海盗舰队。这支海盗舰队曾在突尼斯湾战役前遭到巴赞追击。本战以基督教一方获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Roundway Down was fought on 13 July 1643, during the First English Civil War. A Royalist cavalry force under Lord Wilmot won a crushing victory over the Parliamentarians under Sir William Waller who were besieging Devizes in central Wiltshire, which was defended by Lord Hopton. Roundway Down and Oliver's Castle are about 1.5 km (0.93 mi) north of Devizes and now form part of the North Wessex Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty.

zh.s: 朗德韦唐战役于1643年7月13日第一次英国内战期间发生。威尔莫特勋爵率领的保王派骑兵大败威廉·沃勒爵士指挥的议会军。当时，议会军正在围攻迪韦齐斯；该镇由霍普顿勋爵守卫。朗德韦唐和奥利弗城堡位于迪韦齐斯以北约1.5公里（0.93英里），如今属于北威塞克斯丘陵杰出自然风景区。

en.s: The Battle of Tykocin took place on 13 July 1656 and was one of battle of the Swedish invasion of Poland. It resulted in a victory of Sweden and Brandenburg forces, commanded by Duke Boguslaw Radziwill, and ended siege of Tykocin. On 8 July 1656, Swedish King Charles X Gustav arrived at a military camp of his brother, Duke Adolph John. The camp was located near Nowy Dwor Mazowiecki, and the two leaders discussed news from Swedish-held town of Tykocin in Podlasie. The fortress, located along a strategic route from Warsaw to Lithuania and Swedish Livonia, was besieged by Polish - Lithuanian forces of Colonel Samuel Oskierko.

zh.s: 蒂科钦战役发生于1656年7月13日，是瑞典入侵波兰期间的一场战斗。由博古斯瓦夫·拉齐维乌公爵率领的瑞典和勃兰登堡联军获胜，并结束了对蒂科钦的围城。1656年7月8日，瑞典国王卡尔十世·古斯塔夫抵达其兄弟阿道夫·约翰公爵设在马佐夫舍新庄附近的军营。两人讨论了瑞典控制的波德拉谢地区城镇蒂科钦传来的消息。蒂科钦要塞位于华沙通往立陶宛和瑞典利沃尼亚的战略要道上，当时正遭塞缪尔·奥斯凯尔科上校率领的波兰—立陶宛军队围攻。

en.s: The Battle of Mątwy (Polish: Bitwa pod Mątwami) was the biggest and bloodiest battle of the so-called Lubomirski Rokosz, a rebellion against Polish King John II Casimir, initiated by a magnate and hetman, Jerzy Sebastian Lubomirski. It took place on 13 July 1666 in the village of Mątwy (now a district of Inowrocław), and ended in rebel victory. Royal army of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth lost almost 4000 of its best and most experiences soldiers, who were murdered by Lubomirski's men. Rebel losses are estimated at approximately 200.

zh.s: 蒙特维战役（波兰语：Bitwa pod Mątwami）是所谓的卢博米尔斯基叛乱中规模最大、最血腥的一场战斗。这场叛乱由贵族兼统帅耶日·塞巴斯蒂安·卢博米尔斯基发起，反抗波兰国王扬二世·卡齐米日。战斗于1666年7月13日在蒙特维村（今伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫的一个城区）发生，叛军获胜。波兰—立陶宛联邦王军近4,000名最精锐、最有经验的士兵被卢博米尔斯基的部下杀害；叛军损失约200人。

en.s: The Battle of Altimarlach or Battle of Altimarlech was a Scottish clan battle that took place on 13 July 1680. It was fought between the Clan Campbell and Clan Sinclair.

en.s: The Raid on Teignmouth was a military action by French forces that took place during the Nine Years' War on 13 July 1690. French naval forces having control of the English Channel after their victory at the Battle of Beachy Head, attacked the small of town of Teignmouth. After a naval bombardment, French troops were landed, who then ransacked and burned the place, before leaving unmolested.

zh.s: 蒂格茅斯突袭是法国军队于1690年7月13日在九年战争期间实施的一次军事行动。法国海军在比奇角海战获胜后控制了英吉利海峡，随后袭击了小镇蒂格茅斯。法国军队先以海军炮火轰击，继而登陆，洗劫并焚毁当地，之后无人阻拦地离开。

en.s: The Russo-Turkish War of 1686–1700 was part of the joint European effort to confront the Ottoman Empire. The larger European conflict was known as the Great Turkish War. The Russo-Turkish War began after the Tsardom of Russia joined the European anti-Turkish coalition (Habsburg monarchy, Poland–Lithuania, Venice) in 1686, after Poland-Lithuania agreed to recognize Russian incorporation of Kiev and the left bank of Ukraine.

zh.s: 1686至1700年的俄土战争是欧洲各国联合对抗奥斯曼帝国的一部分。这场更大规模的欧洲冲突被称为大土耳其战争。1686年，波兰立陶宛同意承认俄罗斯兼并基辅和乌克兰左岸后，俄罗斯沙皇国加入由哈布斯堡君主国、波兰立陶宛和威尼斯组成的反土联盟，俄土战争由此爆发。

en.s: Jean-Paul Marat (UK: , US: ; French: [ʒɑ̃pɔl maʁa]; born Mara; 24 May 1743 – 13 July 1793) was a French scientist, physician, political theorist, journalist, and politician. Before the French Revolution, he pursued a career in medicine and science and spent more than ten years abroad. He published works on subjects including optics, electricity, political theory, and criminal law.

zh.s: 让-保罗·马拉（英国英语：；美国英语：；法语：[ʒɑ̃pɔl maʁa]；原姓马拉；1743年5月24日—1793年7月13日）是法国科学家、医生、政治理论家、记者和政治人物。法国大革命前，他从事医学和科学工作，并在国外生活了十多年。他出版过光学、电学、政治理论和刑法等主题的著作。

en.s: The Battle of Trippstadt was a relatively minor French military action in 1794 during the War of the First Coalition. The clash between the French Republican forces and the armies of Prussia and Habsburg Austria was fought over several days (13 to 17 July) in the Palatinate Forest in the German states west of the Rhine River.
en.n: The Battle of Trippstadt between French forces and those of Prussia and Austria begins.

zh.s: 特里普施塔特战役是1794年第一次反法同盟战争期间一场规模较小的法国军事行动。法国共和军与普鲁士和哈布斯堡奥地利军队在莱茵河以西的德意志诸邦境内、普法尔茨森林交战，战斗持续数日，从7月13日打到17日。
zh.n: 法国军队与普鲁士、奥地利军队之间的特里普施塔特战役开始。

en.s: The Battle of the Hyères Islands was a fleet action fought between a combined British and Neapolitan fleet and the French Mediterranean Fleet on 13 July 1795 during the French Revolutionary Wars. Since the start of the war in 1793 the French fleet had suffered a series of damaging defeats and was restricted to limited operations off the French Mediterranean Coast in the face of a determined allied blockade.

zh.s: 耶尔群岛海战是法国大革命战争期间的一场舰队交战，于1795年7月13日发生，交战双方为英国和那不勒斯联合舰队以及法国地中海舰队。自1793年战争爆发以来，法国舰队接连遭受重创，在盟军坚决实施封锁的情况下，只能在法国地中海沿岸附近进行有限行动。

en.s: The Battle of Shubra Khit (also known as the Battle of Chobrakit or the Battle of Chebreïss) was the second major engagement of the French invasion of Egypt and Syria and took place on 13 July 1798. On their march to Cairo, the French army encountered an Ottoman army consisting of Mamluk cavalry and drafted Fellahins under Murad Bey.

zh.s: 舒布拉希特战役又称乔布拉基特战役或谢布赖斯战役，是法国入侵埃及和叙利亚期间的第二场主要交战，发生于1798年7月13日。法军向开罗进军途中，遇到穆拉德贝伊率领的奥斯曼军队，其中包括马穆鲁克骑兵和被征召的埃及农民。

en.s: The Second Battle of Algeciras (also known as the Battle of the Gut of Gibraltar) was fought on 12 July 1801 between a Royal Navy squadron and a larger Spanish and French squadron in the Gut of Gibraltar during the Algeciras campaign of the war of the Second Coalition.

The siege lasted from July 13 to 19 July, during which Russian troops defeated the Persian troops of the crown prince Abbas-Mirza. Soon after this, the fortress capitulated.

en.t: The General Assembly's Institution, now the Scottish Church College, one of the pioneering institutions that ushered the Bengali Renaissance, is founded by Alexander Duff and Raja Ram Mohan Roy, in Calcutta, India
en.s: Scottish Church College is a college affiliated by Calcutta University, India. It offers selective co-educational undergraduate and postgraduate studies and is the oldest continuously running Christian liberal arts and sciences college in Asia. It has been rated (A) by the Indian National Assessment and Accreditation Council. Students and alumni call themselves "Caledonians" in the name of the college festival, "Caledonia".

zh.t: 苏格兰教会学院前身大会学院在印度加尔各答创办，由亚历山大·达夫和罗姆莫罕·罗伊创立；该校是推动孟加拉文艺复兴的先驱机构之一
zh.s: 苏格兰教会学院是印度加尔各答大学的附属学院，提供择优录取的男女合校本科和研究生教育，是亚洲持续运营时间最长的基督教文理学院。该校获印度国家评估与认证委员会评为A级。学生和校友以学院节“卡里多尼亚”的名称自称“卡里多尼亚人”。

en.s: The Danubian Principalities (German: Donaufürstentümer, Russian: Дунайские княжества, Romanian: Principatele Dunărene) was a geopolitical term used for the Ottoman vassal principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia in the period of 1774–1858, a time when the territories were a battleground between the Ottoman Empire, Habsburg Monarchy, and Russian Empire. While Russia returned Moldavia and Wallachia to the Ottoman Empire with the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca (1774), it retained protectorship over the two and also of the Orthodox subjects in all of the Ottoman Empire.

zh.t: 瓦拉几亚通过准宪法性基本法《有机条例》，瓦拉几亚是后来构成罗马尼亚基础的两个多瑙河公国之一
zh.s: 多瑙河公国（德语：Donaufürstentümer；俄语：Дунайские княжества；罗马尼亚语：Principatele Dunărene）是一个地缘政治术语，指1774年至1858年间奥斯曼帝国的两个附庸公国摩尔达维亚和瓦拉几亚。当时，两地是奥斯曼帝国、哈布斯堡君主国和俄罗斯帝国争夺的战场。俄罗斯根据1774年《库楚克凯纳尔吉条约》将摩尔达维亚和瓦拉几亚交还奥斯曼帝国，但仍保有对两地的保护权，也保护奥斯曼帝国境内的东正教臣民。

en.s: The Charleston Workhouse Slave Rebellion was a rebellion of enslaved South Carolinians that took place in Charleston, South Carolina, in July 1849. On July 13, 1849, an enslaved man named Nicholas Kelly led an insurrection, wounding several guards with improvised weapons and liberating 37 enslaved people. Most were quickly captured, and Nicholas and two others were tried and hanged.

zh.t: 查尔斯顿济贫院奴隶起义
zh.s: 查尔斯顿济贫院奴隶起义是1849年7月发生在南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿的一场被奴役南卡罗来纳居民起义。1849年7月13日，一名被奴役者尼古拉斯·凯利领导起义，用自制武器打伤数名看守，并解救了37名被奴役者。大多数人很快被抓回，尼古拉斯和另外两人受审后被处以绞刑。

en.s: Greytown, Nicaragua (also known as San Juan de Nicaragua or San Juan del Norte) was a contested port on the Atlantic Coast of Central America. Nicaragua regarded it as its own former Caribbean outlet, while Britain maintained that it was always part of Mosquitia. In 1852, the protectorate granted self-governing autonomy to the tiny port. It was later bombarded and burned to the ground on July 13, 1854 by the US Navy sloop-of-war USS Cyane.

zh.s: 格雷敦位于尼加拉瓜，也称圣胡安·德尼加拉瓜或圣胡安·德尔诺尔特，是中美洲大西洋沿岸一处存在主权争议的港口。尼加拉瓜认为这里是该国昔日通往加勒比海的出口，英国则认为它一直属于蚊子海岸。1852年，保护国授予这座小港口自治权。1854年7月13日，美国海军战船“塞恩号”炮击并将格雷敦夷为平地。

en.s: The Battle of Corrick's Ford took place on July 13, 1861, on the Cheat River in western Virginia (now the state of West Virginia) as part of the Operations in Western Virginia Campaign during the American Civil War. By later standards the battle was a minor skirmish. Often considered a final part of the Battle of Rich Mountain, it was the end of a series of battles between the forces of Union Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan and Confederate Brig. Gen. Robert S. Garnett. McCellan had defeated part of Garnett's force on July 11, 1861, at the Battle of Rich Mountain.

zh.s: 科里克浅滩战役于1861年7月13日在西弗吉尼亚州（当时属弗吉尼亚州）西部的奇特河畔发生，是美国内战期间西弗吉尼亚战役的一部分。按后来的标准，这场战斗只算小规模交火。它常被视为里奇山战役的最后一部分，也标志着联邦少将乔治·B·麦克莱伦与邦联准将罗伯特·S·加内特所部一系列战斗的结束。7月11日，麦克莱伦曾在里奇山战役中击败加内特所部的一部分。

en.s: The First Battle of Murfreesboro was fought on July 13, 1862, in Rutherford County, Tennessee, as part of the American Civil War. Troops under Confederate cavalry commander Brig. Gen. Nathan Bedford Forrest surprised and quickly overran a Federal hospital, the camps of several small Union units, and the jail and courthouse in Murfreesboro, Tennessee. All of the Union units surrendered to Forrest, and the Confederates destroyed much of the Union's supplies and destroyed railroad track in the area. The primary consequence of the raid was the diversion of Union forces from a drive on Chattanooga.

zh.t: 默弗里斯伯勒第一次战役
zh.s: 默弗里斯伯勒第一次战役于1862年7月13日在田纳西州卢瑟福县发生，是美国内战的一部分。邦联骑兵指挥官内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特准将率军突然袭击并迅速攻占一座联邦医院、数支规模较小的联邦部队营地，以及默弗里斯伯勒的监狱和法院。所有联邦部队都向福雷斯特投降。邦联军队还摧毁了联邦军的大部分补给和当地铁路。这次突袭的主要影响是牵制了原本准备进攻查塔努加的联邦军。

en.s: The Battle of Kock’s Plantation (also spelled Cox’s Plantation and Saint Emma Plantation) was fought July 12–13, 1863, in Ascension Parish, Louisiana, during the American Civil War. It was part of a campaign entitled "Taylor's Operations in West Louisiana (1863)." The Confederate States Army victory left them in control of much of the interior of the Acadiana region.

zh.s: 科克种植园战役也称考克斯种植园战役或圣埃玛种植园战役，于1863年7月12日至13日在美国内战期间的路易斯安那州阿森松堂区发生。此战属于“泰勒在路易斯安那州西部的行动（1863年）”战役。南部邦联军获胜后，控制了阿卡迪亚地区大部分内陆地带。

en.s: The Battle of Camden Point took place on July 13, 1864 near Camden Point, Missouri, USA. During the mid-1864 Paw Paw Rebellion in north-western Missouri, detachments of Federal troops crossed the Missouri River and occupied Platte County, Missouri. At this time a Confederate cavalry force approximately 200-300 strong under Colonel J. C. Thornton was organizing around Camden Point. On July 13, Thornton's men held a picnic in an open pasture near the town. Detachments of the 2nd Colorado Cavalry and 15th Kansas Cavalry, with one piece of artillery, all under command of Colonel Ford, of the Second Colorado, totaling 700 - 1,000 soldiers, ambushed Thornton's picnicking force, routing it and killing two and wounding approximately 25 Confederates.

zh.s: 卡姆登角战役于1864年7月13日在美国密苏里州卡姆登角附近发生。1864年年中，密苏里州西北部爆发波波叛乱，联邦军分队渡过密苏里河并占领了普拉特县。此时，J. C. 桑顿上校率领的约200至300名邦联骑兵正在卡姆登角附近集结。7月13日，桑顿部队在镇附近的一片牧场野餐。由福特上校指挥的联邦军随后伏击了他们；联邦军包括第二科罗拉多骑兵团和第15堪萨斯骑兵团的一些分队、一门火炮，共700至1,000人。桑顿部队溃败，2名邦联军人死亡，约25人受伤。

en.s: The Battle of Frohnhofen or Battle of Laufach took place on 13 July 1866 as part of the Main Campaign of the Prussian Army in the Austro-Prussian War. In a battle lasting several hours, the Prussian 26th Infantry Brigade repulsed attacks by the 3rd (Hessian) Division of the VIII. Corps of the North German Confederation, with the Hessians suffering heavy losses.

zh.s: 弗罗恩霍芬战役，又称劳法赫战役，于1866年7月13日爆发，是普鲁士军队在普奥战争中进行的美因战役的一部分。经过数小时交战，普鲁士第26步兵旅击退了北德意志邦联第八军团黑森第3师的进攻，黑森军伤亡惨重。

en.s: The Petroleum Revolution (Valencian: La Revolució del Petroli) was a libertarian and syndicalist leaning workers' revolution that took place in Alcoy, Alicante, Spain in 1873. The event derives its name from the petroleum-soaked torches carried by revolting workers. During those days, according to chroniclers, the city stank of petroleum.

en.s: The Treaty of Berlin (formally the Treaty between Austria-Hungary, France, Germany, Great Britain and Ireland, Italy, Russia, and the Ottoman Empire for the Settlement of Affairs in the East) was signed on 13 July 1878. In the aftermath of the Russian victory against the Ottoman Empire in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–1878, the major powers restructured the map of the Balkan region.

zh.s: 《柏林条约》的正式名称为《奥匈帝国、法国、德国、大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国、意大利、俄罗斯与奥斯曼帝国关于解决东方问题的条约》，于1878年7月13日签署。1877—1878年俄土战争以俄罗斯战胜奥斯曼帝国告终，随后列强重新划分了巴尔干地区的版图。

en.s: The Bombardment of Alexandria in Egypt by the British Mediterranean Fleet took place on 11–13 July 1882. Admiral Beauchamp Seymour was in command of a fleet of fifteen Royal Navy ironclad ships which had previously sailed to the harbor of Alexandria to support the khedive Tewfik Pasha amid Ahmed 'Urabi's nationalist uprising against his administration and its close ties to British and French financiers.

en.s: The Paknam Incident was a military engagement fought during the Franco-Siamese crisis in July 1893. While sailing off Paknam on Siam's Chao Phraya River, three French ships violated Siamese territory and a Siamese fort and a force of gunboats fired warning shots. In the ensuing battle, France won and blockaded Bangkok, which ended the war.

zh.s: 帕克南事件是1893年法暹危机期间的一次军事冲突。三艘法国舰艇在暹罗湄南河帕克南附近航行时侵入暹罗领海，暹罗炮台和一支炮艇部队向其鸣枪警告。随后双方交战，法国获胜并封锁曼谷，战争由此结束。

en.s: The Battle of Peralejo was a military confrontation between Cuban independence rebels, under the command of Major General Antonio Maceo against the forces of the Spanish Army, under the command of Captain General Arsenio Martínez Campos, which was part of Maceo's First Eastern Campaign during the Cuban War of Independence.

zh.s: 佩拉莱霍战役是古巴独立战争期间马塞奥第一次东部战役的一部分。安东尼奥·马塞奥少将指挥的古巴独立军与阿塞尼奥·马丁内斯·坎波斯上将指挥的西班牙军队交战。

en.s: The Westland by-election was a by-election in the New Zealand electorate of Westland, a semi-urban seat at the west coast of the South Island. The by-election was held on 13 July 1906, and was precipitated by the death of sitting MP, Prime Minister Richard Seddon. The seat was won by his son, Thomas. His sole opponent was Henry Michel, former Mayor of Hokitika.

zh.s: 韦斯特兰补选是新西兰南岛西海岸半城市选区韦斯特兰举行的一次补选，投票日为1906年7月13日。时任议员、总理理查德·塞登去世后，该选区举行补选。他的儿子托马斯当选，唯一的对手是霍基蒂卡前市长亨利·米歇尔。

en.s: The Gorlice–Tarnów offensive during World War I was initially conceived as a minor German offensive to relieve Russian pressure on the Austro-Hungarians to their south on the Eastern Front, but resulted in the Central Powers' chief offensive effort of 1915, causing the total collapse of the Russian lines and their retreat far into Russia.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，戈尔利采—塔尔努夫攻势最初被设想为一次规模有限的德军攻势，目的是减轻东线南部俄军对奥匈军队的压力。但这场攻势后来成为同盟国1915年的主要进攻行动，俄军防线全面崩溃，部队一路撤退到俄罗斯腹地。

en.s: The Battle of Albert (1–13 July 1916) is the British name for the first two weeks of British–French offensive operations of the Battle of the Somme. The Allied preparatory artillery bombardment commenced on 24 June and the British–French infantry attacked on 1 July, on the south bank from Foucaucourt to the Somme and from the Somme north to Gommecourt, 2 mi (3.2 km) beyond Serre.

zh.s: 阿尔贝战役（1916年7月1日至13日）是英国对索姆河战役中英法联军前两周进攻行动的称呼。盟军于6月24日开始炮击，为进攻做准备；英法步兵于7月1日发起攻击，南线从富卡库尔延伸至索姆河，北线则从索姆河向北推进至贡梅库尔，越过塞尔约2英里（3.2公里）。

en.s: The two Battles of Ramadi were fought between the forces of the British and Ottoman Empires in July and September 1917 during World War I. The two sides contested the town of Ramadi in central Iraq, about 100 km (62 miles) west of Baghdad on the south bank of the Euphrates River, where an important Ottoman garrison was quartered.

en.s: Group 1 of the 1930 FIFA World Cup was one of four groups in the opening round of tournament. The group featured Argentina, Chile, France and Mexico. Play began on 13 July 1930 when France defeated Mexico 4–1 in the opening match. Lucien Laurent scored the first goal in World Cup history after 19 minutes to give his side the lead.

en.s: The FIFA World Cup is an international association football competition among the senior men's national teams of the members of the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA), the sport's global governing body. The tournament has been held every four years since the inaugural tournament in 1930, with the exception of 1942 and 1946 during and shortly after World War II.
en.n: The inaugural FIFA World Cup begins in Uruguay.

zh.s: 国际足联世界杯是由国际足球联合会（FIFA）成员的成年男子国家队参加的国际足球赛事。首届赛事于1930年举行，此后通常每四年举办一次；因第二次世界大战及其影响，1942年和1946年停办。
zh.n: 首届国际足联世界杯在乌拉圭开赛。

en.s: The 1930 FIFA World Cup was the first FIFA World Cup, the world championship for men's national football teams. It took place in Uruguay from 13 to 30 July 1930. FIFA, football's international governing body, selected Uruguay as the host nation, as the country would be celebrating the centenary of its first constitution and the Uruguay national football team had retained their football title at the 1928 Summer Olympics.

en.s: The Uprising in Montenegro (Serbo-Croatian: Ustanak u Crnoj Gori / Устанак у Црној Гори), commonly known as the 13 July Uprising (Serbo-Croatian: Trinaestojulski ustanak / Тринаестојулски устанак) was an uprising against Italian occupation forces in Montenegro (Axis occupied Yugoslavia). Initiated by the Communist Party of Yugoslavia on 13 July 1941, it was suppressed within six weeks, but continued at a much lower intensity until Battle of Pljevlja on 1 December 1941.

zh.s: 黑山起义（塞尔维亚-克罗地亚语：Ustanak u Crnoj Gori / Устанак у Црној Гори），通常称为“7月13日起义”（塞尔维亚-克罗地亚语：Trinaestojulski ustanak / Тринаестојулски устанак），是黑山反抗意大利占领军的一场起义，当时南斯拉夫被轴心国占领。南斯拉夫共产党于1941年7月13日发动起义。起义在6周内被镇压，但低强度的抵抗一直持续到1941年12月1日的普列夫利亚战役。

en.s: The Battle of Kolombangara (Japanese: コロンバンガラ島沖海戦) (also known as the Second Battle of Kula Gulf) was a naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II, fought on the night of 12/13 July 1943, off Kolombangara in the Solomon Islands.

en.s: Operation Ostra Brama (Polish: Operacja „Ostra Brama”, lit. 'Operation Sharp Gate') was the Polish Home Army's attempted takeover of Vilnius (Polish: Wilno) in wake of the German Wehrmacht's evacuation, ahead of the approaching Soviet Red Army's Vilnius offensive. A part of a Polish national uprising, Operation Tempest, the action happened on 7–13 July 1944. The operation's main goal was propagandistic – to claim Vilnius for Poland by retaking it before Soviet arrival.

en.s: The Ogaden War, also known as the Ethio-Somali War (Somali: Dagaalkii Xoraynta Soomaali Galbeed, Amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ሶማሊያ ጦርነት, romanized: ye’ītiyop’iya somalīya t’orinet), was a military conflict between Somalia and Ethiopia fought from July 1977 to March 1978 over control of the sovereignty of the Ogaden region. Somalia launched an invasion in support of the Western Somali Liberation Front (WSLF) insurgency, triggering a broader inter-state war.

zh.s: 欧加登战争又称埃塞俄比亚—索马里战争（索马里语：Dagaalkii Xoraynta Soomaali Galbeed；阿姆哈拉语：የኢትዮጵያ ሶማሊያ ጦርነት，转写：ye’ītiyop’iya somalīya t’orinet），是索马里与埃塞俄比亚之间为争夺欧加登地区主权而爆发的军事冲突，持续时间为1977年7月至1978年3月。索马里出兵支持西索马里解放阵线（WSLF）的叛乱，进而引发更大范围的两国战争。

The targets were a convoy of civil guards who had just finished their shift guarding the nearby munitions factory. Two civil guards were killed and three injured, while two ETA members were killed after the civil guards starting the new shift came to the assistance of their colleagues.

en.s: The Lenin Peak disaster occurred on 13 July 1990 when 43 climbers were killed during an avalanche on the 7,134-meter-high mountain peak in northeast Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan (then part of the USSR). The deadly avalanche was triggered by a moment magnitude scale 6.4 earthquake which struck at a depth of 216.8 km beneath the Hindu Kush mountains in neighbouring Afghanistan.

en.s: Operation Tiger (Croatian: Operacija Tigar) was a Croatian Army (HV) offensive conducted in areas of Croatia and Bosnia and Herzegovina near Dubrovnik between 1 and 13 July 1992. It was designed to push the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS) away from the city towards Popovo field and secure a supply route via Rijeka Dubrovačka, which was gained in early June as the siege of Dubrovnik by the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) was lifted.

en.s: STS-70 was the 21st flight of the Space Shuttle Discovery, and the last of 7 shuttle missions to carry a Tracking and Data Relay Satellite (TDRS). This was the first shuttle mission controlled from the new mission control center room at the Johnson Space Center in Houston. STS-70 was also the first flight of the new Block 1 orbiter main engine, designed to improve both engine performance and safety. The mission was launched from Kennedy Space Center in Florida on July 13, 1995, only six days after the landing of sister ship Atlantis, marking the fastest turnaround between flights in the history of the program.

zh.s: STS-70是发现号航天飞机的第21次飞行，也是7次搭载跟踪与数据中继卫星（TDRS）的航天飞机任务中的最后一次。本次任务首次由休斯敦约翰逊航天中心新任务控制室指挥，也是改进发动机性能和安全性的新型Block 1轨道器主发动机首次执行飞行任务。任务于1995年7月13日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射，距姐妹飞船亚特兰蒂斯号着陆仅6天，创下该航天计划史上两次飞行任务之间最快的周转时间。

en.s: The Battle of Wanat occurred on July 13, 2008, when about 200 Taliban guerrillas attacked NATO troops near Quam, in the Waygal district in Afghanistan's far eastern province of Nuristan. The position was defended primarily by United States Army soldiers of the 2nd Platoon, Chosen Company, 2nd Battalion, 503rd Infantry Regiment (Airborne), 173rd Airborne Brigade Combat Team. The Taliban surrounded the remote base and its observation post, attacking it from Quam and surrounding farmland. They destroyed much of the U.S. heavy munitions, broke through American lines, and entered the main base before being repelled by artillery and aircraft.

zh.s: 瓦纳特战役发生于2008年7月13日，约200名塔利班武装人员袭击了北约部队。袭击地点靠近库阿姆，位于阿富汗最东部努里斯坦省的韦伊格勒区。阵地主要由美国陆军第173空降旅战斗队所属第503步兵团第2营“精选连”第2排守卫。塔利班包围偏远基地和观察哨，从库阿姆及周边农田发动攻击。他们摧毁了美军大量重型弹药，突破美军防线并进入主基地，随后被炮火和飞机击退。

en.s: The 2008 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played on 13 July 2008 in the Gaelic Grounds, Limerick. It was contested by Tipperary and Clare. en.s: The 2011 Mumbai bombings (often referred to as 13 July) were a series of three coordinated bomb explosions at different locations in Mumbai, India, on 13 July 2011 between 18:54 and 19:06 IST. The blasts occurred at the Opera House, at Zaveri Bazaar and at Dadar West localities, leaving 26 killed and 130 injured.

en.s: Noar Linhas Aéreas Flight 4896 was a passenger flight which crashed in Boa Viagem, Recife, Brazil, on 13 July 2011. All 16 people aboard died. Shortly after take-off, a mayday was issued and the crew indicated their intention to land on the beach at Boa Viagem.

en.s: United Nations Security Council Resolution 1999 was adopted without a vote on 13 July 2011 after examining the application of the Republic of South Sudan for membership into the United Nations. en.s: A parliamentary election for the 90 deputies to the National Assembly of Slovenia was held on 13 July 2014. Seventeen parties participated, including seven new parties, some of which formed only months before the election took place. Party of Miro Cerar (SMC), a new party led by lawyer and professor Miro Cerar, won the election with over 34% of the vote and 36 seats. Seven political parties won seats in the National Assembly.

en.s: The 2024 Tailteann Cup final was the third final of the Tailteann Cup and the culmination of the 2024 Tailteann Cup, the GAA's second-tier Gaelic football competition for county teams. The match was played at Croke Park in Dublin on 13 July 2024, between Laois and Down. The game was played prior to the All Ireland football semi-final between Kerry and Armagh.

zh.s: 2024年泰尔特安杯决赛是该赛事的第3场决赛，也是2024年泰尔特安杯的收官赛。该赛事是盖尔式运动协会（GAA）为郡级球队举办的第二级别盖尔式足球比赛。决赛于2024年7月13日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，由劳斯郡队对阵唐郡队。比赛在凯里郡队对阵阿马郡队的全爱尔兰半决赛之前举行。

en.s: The 2024 Russian Super Cup (Russian: Суперкубок России по футболу 2024) was the 22nd edition of the Russian Super Cup, an annual football match organised jointly by the Russian Football Union and the Russian Premier League. It was contested by the reigning champions of the Russian Cup and the Russian Premier League, FC Zenit Saint Petersburg and the runners-up of the 2023–24 Premier League, FC Krasnodar.

zh.s: 2024年俄罗斯超级杯（俄语：Суперкубок России по футболу 2024）是第22届俄罗斯超级杯，由俄罗斯足球协会和俄罗斯超级联赛联合举办。参赛球队是俄罗斯杯卫冕冠军圣彼得堡泽尼特，以及2023—24赛季俄罗斯超级联赛亚军克拉斯诺达尔。

en.s: The 2025 Evolution was a women's professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the second Evolution event and took place on July 13, 2025, at the State Farm Arena in Atlanta, Georgia, held for wrestlers from the promotion's Raw, SmackDown, and NXT brand divisions. This was the first Evolution and the first all-women's professional wrestling event to broadcast on both Netflix and Peacock, and the first Evolution since the inaugural 2018 event seven years prior.

zh.s: 2025年Evolution是WWE举办的一场女子职业摔角付费点播及直播赛事，是Evolution系列的第二场赛事。比赛于2025年7月13日在佐治亚州亚特兰大的州立农业球馆举行，参赛者来自WWE旗下Raw、SmackDown和NXT品牌。这是首场在Netflix和Peacock两个平台播出的Evolution赛事，也是首场在这两个平台播出的全女子职业摔角赛事。距离2018年首届赛事，已有7年未举办Evolution。

en.s: The 2025 FIFA Club World Cup final was the final match of the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup, the 21st edition of the premier competition for men's club soccer teams organized by FIFA. The match was played at MetLife Stadium at the Meadowlands Sports Complex in East Rutherford, New Jersey, near New York City, on July 13, 2025. It was contested between English club Chelsea and French club Paris Saint-Germain.

zh.s: 2025年国际足联俱乐部世界杯决赛是该届赛事的最后一场比赛。该赛事是国际足联为男子足球俱乐部举办的顶级赛事，第21届比赛于2025年举行。决赛于2025年7月13日在新泽西州东卢瑟福的大都会人寿体育场举行，球场位于梅多兰兹体育综合体内，靠近纽约市。对阵双方是英格兰俱乐部切尔西队和法国俱乐部巴黎圣日耳曼队。

en.s: On 13 July 2025, fighting began between Druze and Bedouin armed groups in the city of Suwayda and its surrounding villages in southern Syria. The Syrian transitional government deployed the Armed Forces to the area to restore order between 14 and 16 July. A ceasefire agreement was reached between Druze leaders and the government on 15 July, but one of the Druze leaders, Hikmat al-Hijri, called for armed resistance against the government and Bedouin groups.

zh.t: 叙利亚南部冲突（2025年7月至9月）
zh.s: 2025年7月13日，叙利亚南部苏韦达市及周边村庄的德鲁兹武装与贝都因武装发生交火。7月14日至16日，叙利亚过渡政府派军队前往当地恢复秩序。7月15日，德鲁兹领导人与政府达成停火协议，但德鲁兹领导人之一希克马特·希杰里呼吁武装抵抗政府和贝都因武装。

en.s: The Galway Film Fleadh (pronounced [fʲlʲaː]; Irish for "festival") is an international film festival founded in 1989 as part of the Galway Arts Festival. Describing itself as Ireland’s leading film festival, the event is held every July in Galway, Ireland. In 2022, a MovieMaker magazine panel of U.S. filmmakers, critics and industry executives included the festival on its list of the "50 Film Festivals Worth the Entry Fee".

zh.s: 戈尔韦电影节（读作[fʲlʲaː]；爱尔兰语意为“节庆”）是一项国际电影节，1989年作为戈尔韦艺术节的一部分创办。该活动自称是爱尔兰首屈一指的电影节，每年7月在爱尔兰戈尔韦举办。2022年，《MovieMaker》杂志的一个美国电影人、影评人和行业高管评审团将该电影节列入“值得支付报名费的50个电影节”名单。

en.s: The Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival (Korean: 부천국제판타스틱영화제; Hanja: 富川國際판타스틱映畵祭), or BiFan, formerly known as Puchon International Fantastic Film Festival or PiFan, is an international film festival held annually in July in Bucheon, South Korea. Inaugurated in 1997, the festival focuses on South Korean and international horror, thriller, mystery and fantasy films, with particular attention to Asian cinema from East Asia and Southeast Asia.

zh.s: 富川国际奇幻电影节（韩语：부천국제판타스틱영화제；汉字：富川國際판타스틱映畵祭），简称BiFan，原名富川国际奇幻电影节（Puchon International Fantastic Film Festival，PiFan），是韩国富川每年7月举办的国际电影节。电影节创办于1997年，主要展映韩国及国际恐怖、惊悚、悬疑和奇幻电影，尤其关注东亚和东南亚电影。
